acceptanceCriteria.text: Valid parent checkpoint launches a child with same `prefix_id`, new Nawabari attachment and distinct `execution_state_id`.
Parent currentness is revalidated immediately before physical creation.
Two children from one parent use distinct worktrees/sessions.
Nawabari failure, attachment mismatch, persistence fault and Zellij failure cannot falsely mark a child running.
Restart reconciles planned/attached/launched/failed states without duplicate physical mutation.
Manager never directly creates/reserves/cleans Git branches/worktrees.
Existing independent-root Manager launch remains supported.

issue.title: feat(manager): launch forked executions from persisted Canon checkpoints
